headline: Jumia Trims Workforce by 3% in Ongoing Push Toward Profitability
summary: Pan-African e-commerce platform Jumia trimmed its headcount by 3% during the third quarter, reducing its overall workforce to 1,720 employees as part of its ongoing cost-cutting strategy.
why: Jumia operates across multiple African markets and has been reorganizing operations to stem operational cash burn and reach positive EBITDA.

impacts.name: Jumia Technologies AG
impacts.why: Further staff reductions lower operating expenditure and support progress toward breakeven.
